checks.name: schema
checks.detail: task record has the required fields in the required form

checks.name: hashes
checks.detail: file and pixel hashes match the task record
checks.limit: Detects a changed file, not a wrong one.

checks.name: question_matches_data
checks.detail: the question is exactly what the generator words for this scene
checks.limit: Shows the stored question is the one the generator words for this scene.

checks.name: rerender
checks.detail: re-rendering the stored scene reproduces the PNG pixel for pixel
checks.limit: Same renderer, same machine: shows the PNG is a pure function of the data, not that the renderer draws correctly.

checks.name: read_image
checks.detail: train-coloured pixels found in the plot: IC 41221, RE 37676, FR 36568
checks.limit: Finds the train colours in the PNG; uses the plot rectangle, station heights, time span and colours recorded by the renderer as calibration.

checks.name: timetable_matches_data
checks.detail: all 46 trains drawn along their whole path (lowest own-colour share 91%, train 6102), each numbered at its start, and no stray train pixels
checks.limit: Every train path from the data is traced in the PNG in its colour, its number sits at its start, and no train pixel is unexplained; does not rebuild the timetable from pixels alone.

checks.name: independent_answer
checks.detail: solving from the PNG gives 17; the reference is 17
checks.limit: Second solver (time sampling, not crossing algebra) driven by the question text; works from the stored data, which the pixel check ties to the image.

checks.name: answer_not_in_question
checks.detail: the answer does not appear in the question text

checks.name: fingerprints
checks.detail: 4 armed and 0 disarmed fingerprints, strategies pairwise distinct
checks.limit: Checks the stored table is self-consistent, not that the list of shortcuts is complete.

checks.name: labels_legible
checks.detail: 78 labels: capital height at least 7.0 px at 0.667x, contrast measured in the PNG, none overlapping
checks.limit: Assumes a worst-case downscale of 0.667x; real provider resize policies are unknown.

checks.name: ocr_labels
checks.detail: Tesseract not installed on this machine; OCR runs in the Docker image
checks.limit: Runs only where Tesseract is installed (the Docker image); samples labels on dense drawings.

checks.name: image_dependence
checks.detail: same question text, different image, different answer (16)
checks.limit: Shows the question text alone does not determine the answer; guessing rates are measured separately by the blind baseline.

checks.name: tolerance
checks.detail: the answer is exact (a count, a train number or a list of train numbers); no tolerance needed
checks.limit: No task in this family has a continuous numeric answer.
